## Sub-agent (task tool) usage guide
You have access to the 'task' tool which can spawn sub-agents for complex work. Use it when:

Do NOT use the task tool just to avoid work — use it when it genuinely improves efficiency.

If repair is unavailable or the retry remains blocked, report that check as unverified with the blocker; continue independent work.

Fix this real MiniCode repository defect. This workspace is the full active Python source and baseline test snapshot at commit 9aaa6a434ae0a86766d28f8b1b91529451a31eb8.

When the parent dispatches several read-only task calls concurrently, child dispatch receives shifted or missing parent state. Follow-up sessions fail, child todo state can contaminate the parent, and deadline/skill/user-interaction restrictions can be lost.

Required observable behavior:
- Concurrent task dispatch must preserve the same parent continuation-session store and parent todo state that serial dispatch uses.
- Each child retains independent todo contents; its todo writes must not overwrite the parent's work list.
- The original task deadline, skill-load authority and user-interaction prohibition must reach every child consistently.
- A child must not ask the end user, and a follow-up via continue_subagent_id after a parallel batch must successfully reuse the finished child's history.
- Preserve actual read-only parallel scheduling and existing serial/write-task behavior.

Investigate the implementation and its callers, make the repair, and verify it. Keep unrelated behavior and existing public interfaces compatible. You may modify only: minicode/agent_loop.py, tests/test_eval_regression.py. Existing tests are read-only; you may add regression tests in tests/test_eval_regression.py. Use installed dependencies; no network, dependency installation or model API calls are needed to test this defect.

The focused baseline tests are compatibility checks, not proof the new defect is repaired. Add and run a focused regression reproducing the described failure, then report what changed and the verification result.

Observed failure: when the parent dispatches several read-only task calls concurrently (async spawn + poll batch), child dispatch receives shifted or missing parent state. Symptoms: follow-up sessions via continue_subagent_id after a parallel batch fail to reuse the finished child's history; child todo writes can contaminate/overwrite the parent's work list; the original task deadline, skill-load authority and user-interaction prohibition may be shifted or lost per child. Serial dispatch and write-task dispatch behave correctly.

Required observable behavior after repair:
1. Concurrent read-only task dispatch must preserve the same parent continuation-session store and parent todo state that serial dispatch uses.
2. Each child retains independent todo contents; child todo writes must not overwrite the parent's work list.
3. The original task deadline, skill-load authority and user-interaction prohibition must reach every child consistently.
4. A child must never ask the end user; a follow-up via continue_subagent_id after a parallel batch must successfully reuse the finished child's history.
5. Preserve actual read-only parallel scheduling and existing serial/write-task behavior; keep existing public interfaces compatible.

Constraints:
- Modify ONLY minicode/agent_loop.py and tests/test_eval_regression.py. Every other path is read-only; existing tests (e.g. tests/test_sub_agent_isolation.py) are read-only snapshots.

Every collected test there must complete setup/call/teardown and pass; no skip/xfail/xpass/zero collection/timeout.
- Run tests via pytest only; no shell concatenation or other external commands.
- IMPORTANT completion gate: before finishing, run BOTH verification checks yourself and iterate until both pass in the same final state of the files; a check failure left outstanding marks the whole change incomplete.

a) python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_sub_agent_isolation.py -k "scheduled_concurrently or stay_serial or mixed_sub_agent_batch or undecidable"
b) python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_eval_regression.py

Deliver: a minimal focused fix in minicode/agent_loop.py restoring state isolation/parity between serial and concurrent read-only dispatch, plus the new regression test file, plus a summary of root cause, the change, and verification results.
